name: tt-income-tax
description: Trinidad and Tobago personal income tax for the 2026 year of income, for resident and non-resident individuals, employees and the self-employed. Covers the 25% rate on chargeable income up to TT$1,000,000 and 30% above, the TT$90,000 personal allowance, tertiary education and other deductions, the business levy of 0.6% for the self-employed, health surcharge, quarterly instalments, the 30 April return date (2025 returns extended to 2 November 2026), late filing penalties and 20% interest, and the remittance basis for persons not ordinarily resident. Trigger on Trinidad income tax, TT personal allowance, BIR, IRD Trinidad, self-employed Trinidad, business levy individual. Built from the Income Tax Act and IRD pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
